# langfuse_skill (Resource)

Manage a skill in a project using project-scoped credentials. A skill is a versioned set of text files with a root `SKILL.md` whose YAML frontmatter holds the skill `name` and `description`. The resource tracks one version: changing the files or the commit message creates a new version, while labels and tags are changed in place. Versions created outside Terraform are not tracked. Destroying the resource deletes all versions of the skill. Import format: project_public_key:project_secret_key:skill_name (imports the latest version).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "langfuse_skill" "example" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "release-notes"
  commit_message     = "Initial version"
  labels             = ["production"]
  tags               = ["docs"]

  # Use file("${path.module}/skill/SKILL.md") to load files from disk.
  files = {
    "SKILL.md"            = <<-EOT
      ---
      name: release-notes
      description: Write release notes from a list of merged changes.
      ---
      # Release notes

      Group the changes by type and follow references/style.md.
    EOT
    "references/style.md" = "Use short, imperative sentences.\n"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `files` (Map of String) Files of the skill as a map of path to UTF-8 text content. Must contain a root `SKILL.md` that starts with YAML frontmatter holding `name` and `description`.
- `name` (String) Name of the skill: lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens. It must equal the `name` in the `SKILL.md` frontmatter. Changing it forces a new skill.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.

### Optional

- `commit_message` (String) Commit message of the tracked version.
- `labels` (Set of String) Labels of the tracked version, for example `production`. A label points to one version at a time. The `latest` label is managed by Langfuse and cannot be set.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags of the skill. Tags apply to all versions of the skill.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the skill, read from the `SKILL.md` frontmatter.
- `id` (String) The name of the skill.
- `version` (Number) Version number tracked by this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langfuse_skill.example "${PROJECT_PUBLIC_KEY}:${PROJECT_SECRET_KEY}:${SKILL_NAME}"
```
